title: Coastal Calm - Spring 2027
brief:
# Sourcing Brief — "Coastal Calm" Collection, Spring 2027

**Brand:** Harbor & Hearth (fictional DTC home decor brand)
**In-store / on-site date:** 2027-03-15
**Target margin (IMU):** 65%

## Theme
Relaxed coastal living: sand, sea-glass and oat tones; natural textures; matte or reactive glazes;
nothing glossy or "nautical kitsch" (no anchors, no rope prints).

## Items requested

### SKU A — Ceramic table vase
- Height 25–30 cm, stoneware preferred
- Colors: sea-glass green, sand, oat (matte or reactive glaze)
- Retail price: $48
- Must be watertight; must pass drop-test packaging (ISTA 1A)

### SKU B — Linen throw pillow cover
- 50 × 50 cm (20" × 20"), hidden zipper
- 100% linen preferred; linen-cotton blend acceptable if ≥55% linen
- Colors: oat, sea-glass, stripe (oat/white)
- Retail price: $34
- OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification required

## Please reply with
Designs/photos, materials, FOB unit price, MOQ, production lead time, sampling time & cost,
payment terms, and port of loading.
